t.rel: A small principality in the Pyrenees between France and Spain. The president of France and the Spanish bishop of Urgell are its co-princes.
t.know: The only country with Catalan as its official language.
t.etext: A small country in the Pyrenees whose main income comes from tourism, skiing, duty-free shopping and finance. It is not an EU member but uses the euro.
